# Glossary {#sec-glossary-system-design}

Every notion this tutorial defines, in alphabetical order, with its definition and chapter. The list grows as the
chapters are written.

## A

- **Accuracy between retrainings and the cost of skew** (average accuracy, exponential decay, retraining cost, train-serve skew): @prp-freshness
  (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Adaptive throttling, bounded queues and goodput** (sent and rejected requests, latency of a bounded queue, useful throughput under overload): @prp-overload
  (@sec-reliability-and-operations)
- **Admission bounds of rate limiters** (token bucket, sliding window log, fixed window and sliding window counters): @thm-rate-limits (@sec-reliability-and-operations)
- **Agent loop, tools, planning and reflection, workflows, the Model Context Protocol, durable tool calls, budgets and multi-agent systems**:
  @def-agent (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Analytical storage** (OLTP and OLAP, row and column layouts, run-length and dictionary encoding, partitions, warehouses,
  lakes, star schemas): @def-analytical-storage (@sec-batch-and-stream-processing)
- **Architectural characteristic**: @def-architectural-characteristic (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
- **Atomic commitment and two-phase commit** (participants, votes, agreement, validity, prepared and in-doubt participants,
  blocking): @def-atomic-commit (@sec-distributed-transactions)
- **Authentication and authorisation** (credentials, sessions, bearer tokens, JSON Web Tokens):
  @def-auth-session-token (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Availability** (with downtime, nines, error budget, SLO and SLA): @def-availability
  (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
- **Availability, capacity and failover of regions** (correlated failures, $N + k$, lost writes, failover time): @prp-regions (@sec-reliability-and-operations)

## B

- **Backlog of a queue under a burst** (fluid model, drain time, waits, random arrivals):
  @prp-backlog (@sec-messaging-and-event-streams)
- **Batch and online inference, dynamic batching, cascades, shadow and canary rollout, and drift**: @def-model-serving (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Batching trade-off and the economics of cascades** (throughput limit, batching delay, capacity, cascade cost): @prp-dynamic-batching
  (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Block, file and object storage** (blocks, files and directories, network-attached storage, buckets and keys,
  distributed file system, chunks and master): @def-storage-kinds (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Bloom filter false-positive rate** (probability of a zero bit, optimal number of hash functions, bits per key):
  @prp-bloom-false-positive (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **B-tree height** (minimum degree, pages read per lookup): @prp-btree-height (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Bytes scanned, runs and pruning**: @prp-columnar (@sec-batch-and-stream-processing)
- **Byzantine faults and Byzantine quorums** (equivocation, $3f + 1$ replicas, vouched-for values): @def-byzantine
  (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)

## C

- **Cache load, latency and staleness**: @prp-cache-load (@sec-caching)
- **Cache patterns** (hit ratio, cache-aside, read-through, write-through, write-back, write-around): @def-cache-patterns (@sec-caching)
- **CAP properties and PACELC** (atomic consistency, availability, partitions, CP and AP): @def-cap (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **CAP theorem** (asynchronous and partially synchronous models): @thm-cap (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Circuit breaker, calls through** (outage calls, closing after recovery, false openings, rate thresholds): @prp-circuit-breaker (@sec-reliability-and-operations)
- **Cold starts, concurrency and the cost crossover** (warm period, cold fraction, functions against servers): @prp-cold-start
  (@sec-architecture-styles)
- **Collisions of random identifiers** (birthday bounds, bits needed, structured identifiers): @prp-id-collision
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Commit wait and physical clocks** (external consistency from the start and commit-wait rules, length of the wait,
  Lamport's condition): @thm-commit-wait (@sec-distributed-transactions)
- **Components, coupling and deployment models** (logical components, dependency graph, afferent, efferent and total coupling, instability,
  technical and domain partitioning, monolithic and distributed deployment): @def-components (@sec-architecture-styles)
- **Compounding steps, verification, budgets, idempotency and voting** (agent reliability): @prp-agent-reliability (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Concurrency, the batch knob, cost per token and batching waste** (LLM serving capacity): @prp-llm-capacity (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Conditional writes, unique slots and holds** (lost updates, double bookings, capacity held, optimistic retries):
  @prp-reservation (@sec-distributed-transactions)
- **Consensus and replicated state machines** (agreement, validity, termination, crash faults): @def-consensus (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Consensus quorums** (majorities, $2f + 1$ processes, FLP): @prp-consensus-quorums (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Consistency models** (linearisable, sequential, causal, eventual, session guarantees): @def-consistency-models
  (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Consistent hashing** (keys moved by modular and consistent hashing, largest share, virtual nodes): @thm-consistent-hashing
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Consumer groups** (range assignment, order per key, duplicates and losses after a crash):
  @prp-consumer-group (@sec-messaging-and-event-streams)
- **Content delivery network** (edge servers, cache key, freshness lifetime, hit ratio, purge and versioning):
  @def-cdn (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Content delivery network service** (GeoDNS, API gateway, metadata and storage services, origin pulls, fingerprinted assets):
  @def-cdn-design (@sec-case-studies-infrastructure)
- **Coordination services** (locks, sessions, leases, fencing tokens, lock-delay): @def-coordination (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Cost and recall of an inverted-file index, chunk coverage and semantic caching**: @prp-retrieval (@sec-ml-llm-and-agent-systems)
- **Counting and top-K service** (streaming count-min path, batch exact buckets, serving layer, sharded hot counters): @def-topk-dashboard
  (@sec-case-studies-infrastructure)
- **Count-min sketch, error of** (one-sided error, width and depth, merging): @thm-count-min (@sec-batch-and-stream-processing)
- **Coupling, sums, ranges and reach of** (total coupling, instability bounds, change propagation, network calls per request): @prp-coupling
  (@sec-architecture-styles)
